name: @jeldon/amplify
description: Domain-agnostic content amplification. generateKit() produces per-channel distribution copy (GBP/FB/IG/LinkedIn/newsletter/podcast/reel script) under an optional educational-CTA policy; importToCarouselStudio() hands an article to an external carousel studio; scheduleArticleNewsletter() queues a Brevo campaign through one BrevoClient. Every prompt/channel is read from pack.voice + pack.amplify — nothing about any vertical is hardcoded.
